item.title: Invent A Courier Then Reuse

turns.text: Draw a square storybook picture of a little robot courier at a train station. She has a round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag. No text.

Now make two more separate square pictures of that exact robot: delivering a parcel at a cottage door, and sheltering from rain under a giant mushroom. Keep her design and the storybook style exactly like the first picture. No text on these either.

item.tests: Creates a character from words, then preserves its generated design and visual style in two follow-up scenes.

answer_sheet.Character design: A little robot courier with a round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag.
answer_sheet.Follow-up reference: Reuse the exact robot design established in the first generated train-station picture.
answer_sheet.Scenes and output count: One initial train-station picture, then two additional pictures: delivering a parcel at a cottage door and sheltering under a giant mushroom in the rain. Three pictures total.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Square storybook illustrations, consistent with the first image; standard free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The initial square illustration shows the robot courier at a recognisable train station.
The robot has a round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag in all three images.
The two follow-up images preserve the first robot's specific shape, proportions and design details rather than redesigning her.
One follow-up shows her delivering a parcel at a cottage door; the other shows her sheltering beneath a giant mushroom with rain visible around it.
Three separate square pictures share a consistent storybook illustration style and contain no text.
